label: Act and fact substitution at one bearer: extension criterion and conditional model
paraphrase: For one supplied nature judgment on the three fixed-bearer contents, a criterion on their world extensions licenses substitution of coextensive exercise and existence. In the existing conditional-exercise model with bearer true, the two unconditional contents are coextensive and differ in extension from the conditional. The lifted nature takes the conditional alone and admits an extension criterion. A changed judgment accepts the conditional and unconditional exercise while rejecting the existence fact, so it admits no extension criterion. Its projection to world predicates nevertheless satisfies the extensional identity-to-essential-existence bridge. This is a structural test of the projection, with no metaphysical admissibility claim.
